dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Come to think of it, someone left a message at the Adventurers' Guild asking us to visit a new shop in Bayda Harbor... A new shop in Bayda Harbor?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Who could it be? Paimon's got a feeling something good's waiting for us... Let's go take a look!
